research_question: What are the separate and joint effects of fixed measurement-calibrated VLP-16 corruption and randomized decoded-command delay under an otherwise identical SA1 training contract?

terminology.sensor_factor: fixed measurement-calibrated LiDAR corruption, not per-episode sensor-parameter domain randomization
terminology.delay_factor: randomized actuator command delay U{0,1,2}, with velocity scale and motor lag fixed at identity
terminology.forbidden_claim: This experiment does not test full physics, full actuator, or full domain randomization.

training_contract.model_init_seed_semantics: Resolve to the run seed after environment construction and immediately before network construction.

common_contract.temporal_observation: K8 end-to-end LiDAR CNN with issued-action history

training_contract.run_order: Blocked randomization by training seed; randomize A/B/C/D order within each seed before launch.
training_contract.estimate_basis: Historical SA1 required about 7 hours for 600 iterations on this workstation.

blocking_instrumentation_gap: The current common fixed-Gate outputs do not yet provide traversal time, path efficiency, and minimum clearance consistently for every scenario.
No formal evaluation may start until these fields are logging-only, schema-locked, and smoke-tested or the protocol is explicitly superseded before seeing results.

analysis_contract.descriptive_summary: Per-cell and per-scenario mean, standard deviation, and 95 percent confidence interval across the three training seeds.
analysis_contract.rate_direction: For failure rates, negative effects are improvements; for success rate, positive effects are improvements.
analysis_contract.multiplicity: SR, CR, and TO by pre-registered scenario are primary; traversal time, path efficiency, and clearance are secondary. Do not search post hoc for the best checkpoint or seed.
analysis_contract.paper_claim_boundary: The result can support claims about fixed measured LiDAR corruption, randomized command delay, and their interaction at the frozen 600-iteration SA1 budget only.

historical_evidence_boundary.finding: Before 2026-08-30, the training entrypoint did not apply no_domain_randomization to the event-level DR term although evaluation did.
historical_evidence_boundary.consequence: Historical checkpoints cannot be retroactively asserted to have physics/external-force DR disabled solely from their ExperimentConfig.
historical_evidence_boundary.new_protocol_requirement: Runtime logs must contain the [NO_DR] marker and the intended VLP16 and actuator markers for every formal run.
